detects: Claude Code events are captured and buffered, but tagged source="claude" instead of source="claude-code"
why: THE case this suite exists for. Everything downstream of the event looks healthier than a healthy run: the hook exits 0, buffer.jsonl grows, the event count goes up, `status` is happy, `doctor` is happy. Only the one field that decides attribution is wrong, and the backend cannot attribute the events. An agent pattern-matching on 'events present = capture works' scores this PASS. Catching it requires actually reading the source field against the table in features/capture.md — the difference between an agent that counts events and one that verifies them.
